channel.title: SteadiDay Blog - Health & Wellness for Adults 50+
channel.description: Health and wellness tips for adults 50+.

item.title: best-medication-reminder-apps-seniors.html
item.description: Medisafe, Pill Reminder, CareZone, MyChart and SteadiDay compared side by side to help seniors and caregivers choose the best medication reminder app.

item.title: The Mediterranean Diet: A Beginner's Guide for Seniors
item.description: New to the Mediterranean diet? This seniors guide covers what to eat, the health benefits, and simple steps to start today. Backed by research.

item.title: Fish Oil and Brain Health: What the Science Really Shows
item.description: A 2026 USC trial confirmed fish oil reaches the aging brain but found no cognitive benefit. Learn what that means if you take fish oil for brain health.

item.title: Generic Hormone Therapy Patch for Menopause Approved
item.description: The FDA has approved the first generic hormone therapy patch for menopause. Learn what women 50+ should know about cost, safety and what to ask your doctor.

item.title: Sodium and Your Heart: How Much Is Too Much?
item.description: How much sodium per day after 50? The 2,300 mg and 1,500 mg limits explained, where hidden salt comes from, and how fast cutting back lowers blood pressure.

item.title: Walk This Way to Ease Knee Osteoarthritis Pain
item.description: A year-long trial found a personalized foot-angle change eased knee osteoarthritis pain as well as medication. Learn how gait retraining works and how to start.

item.title: Vitamin B12 Deficiency and Fracture Risk After 50
item.description: A study of 1.9M health records links vitamin B12 deficiency to 33% higher fracture risk in adults 50+. Learn what it means and when to ask for a B12 test.

item.title: Walk Faster to Live Longer After 50
item.description: A 64,000-person study links walking pace and longevity over 50. Learn how a brisk pace of about 100 steps per minute fits into your daily routine.

item.title: Gentle Yoga for Seniors: Busting 5 Beginner Myths
item.description: Gentle yoga for seniors: what research says about five beginner myths on flexibility, chair yoga, safety and age, plus four easy poses to try this week.

item.title: How Loneliness Cuts Healthy Years After 50
item.description: A 2026 Tulane study found loneliness and social isolation cost up to 5.8 disease-free years after 50. Learn what that means and how to rebuild connection.

item.title: Hearing Aids May Slow Brain Inflammation, Study Finds
item.description: New biomarker research from the ACHIEVE trial shows hearing aids slow brain neuroinflammation. Learn what it means for hearing aids and brain health after 50.

item.title: How Your Diet Affects Biological Age After 60
item.description: New research shows adults 65–75 who cut dietary fat or animal protein lowered their biological age in 4 weeks. Learn how to apply it to your own meals.

item.title: Fire Safety Myths That Put Seniors at Real Risk
item.description: These home fire safety myths put seniors at greater risk, from smoke alarm placement to escape time. Learn what keeps your household safer.

item.title: 2026-09-14-new-fall-vaccine-rules-every.html
item.description: New fall vaccine rules for adults over 65: why four medical societies now advise a second COVID dose and broader RSV shots, plus the new mRNA flu vaccine.

item.title: Gut Health Trends for Seniors: What Actually Works
item.description: Kombucha, kefir or probiotic pills? Learn what research says about gut health trends for seniors, which fermented foods help, and how to start.

item.title: A Simple Blood Test Now Screens for Alzheimer's at 55
item.description: The FDA-cleared Elecsys pTau217 Alzheimer's blood test for adults over 55 can replace a PET scan as a first step. Learn what it means for your next visit.

item.title: 5 Balance Lessons That Could Prevent a Fall at Home
item.description: Five evidence-based lessons on balance exercises for seniors, from ankle strength to the Otago program, with simple ways to help prevent falls at home.

item.title: 2026-08-27-how-seniors-can-start-walking.html
item.description: Walking exercise for seniors is one of the safest ways to boost heart health, memory and mobility. Learn how to start safely and keep the habit going.

item.title: Key Nutrients Women Over 50 Actually Need
item.description: The nutrients women over 50 need shift after menopause. Learn how much calcium, vitamin D, iron and B12 you need, and why testing before supplements helps.

item.title: Breast Screening Guidelines for Women 50: What's Changed
item.description: Breast screening guidelines for women 50+ changed in 2024. Learn how often to get a mammogram, what dense breasts mean, and how to catch up after a gap.
